title: Breakwater: High Water
concept: A storm-coast rescue action-adventure built around Gaugework: three linked sluices change basin water state, intended to alter route access, ground traction, debris movement, and enemy cover.
innovation_assessment: Gaugework is a world-state mechanic with tactical and traversal consequences in the source. Runtime QA did not validate those linked effects or complete the mission loop.

stack.asset_license_source: Project-local generated art assets; the run record reports 57 ImageGen invocations including failed attempts, 50 generated outputs and 47 individually listed project-local paths. Current vehicle, forest-floor, ground and sky maps are generated/processed color and derived response textures, not scanned or complete measured PBR sets. Vehicle exteriors use CC0 1.0 Innerscene glTF (credits in assets/VEHICLE_ASSET_CREDITS.md). Audio is procedural; sixteen narrator WAVs were synthesized with Microsoft Zira Desktop en-US using Windows System.Speech; redistribution rights for those recordings were not independently confirmed.

features: separate master, effects, coastal ambience, music and narrator buses
narrator voice ducking across effects, ambience, music and vehicle streams
engine/rotor tone and level linked to vehicle state and RPM
five generated weapon-specific reports and layered rocket-explosion sound
surface-dependent water, gravel and concrete impacts
distance attenuation and stereo panning
line-sampled terrain/obstacle occlusion with muffled variants
two delayed echo taps for distant reports
caption toggle and Wide/Dialogue Focus mix profiles
tide-height-responsive coastal surf/foam layer
adaptive score harmony and tension driven by rescue progress and nearby alerted enemies
multi-harmonic car, prop-aircraft, and helicopter engine layers driven by RPM/load
underwater source/listener muffling and additional attenuation
reflection queue capped at 48 pending taps
limitations: occlusion and echo are approximations; no full acoustic geometry propagation or convolution reverb
physical-speaker or headphone output quality was not measured
redistribution rights for generated voice output were not independently confirmed
all four objective cues were verified, but not every failure/combat/weapon narrator cue was exercised
Procedural vehicle and score layers are synthesized approximations, not field recordings or studio performances.
